author: Animan
description:
10 Revenge Anime Where the MC Becomes the Villain — dark, morally grey main characters who stopped being heroes and became the scariest thing on screen. From Death Note and Code Geass to Devilman Crybaby, these anime heroes went too far.

We all love a good revenge story… until the hero keeps walking straight past justice and becomes the monster. In this Top 10 I break down the anime protagonists who didn't beat the villains — they replaced them. Expect power fantasies gone cold, slow-burn con jobs, beautiful monsters, and one prince who became history's greatest villain on purpose.

⏱️ Chapters are below — jump to any pick.

💬 Who did I leave out? Drop your "where's Eren / Guts / Keyaru" picks in the comments and make your case.

👍 Like if the hero scared you more than the villain, and subscribe for more dark anime breakdowns every week.
